items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions Fred Clough as a Columbia engineer who did sessions for Dave Brubeck, but the interviewee does not explicitly confirm a personal relationship or interaction in the provided text.

ctx.x: Were the first recordings that you made for Columbia in the studio without as many mics and so-on as they do now? I wasn’t around for those.
No, but we had great, famous engineers. Columbia had the time guys: Clough. Fred?
